Name: Countdown
Description: Countdown timer, countdown to a date or daily time, stopwatch with laps, and pomodoro, with progress ring, snooze, sound and desktop notifications.

systems.garcia.countdown.timer.Name: Countdown Timer
systems.garcia.countdown.timer.Tooltip: Tap to start/pause, hold to reset. While ringing: tap to dismiss, hold to snooze. On a dial: rotate to adjust, press to start/pause, touch to reset.

systems.garcia.countdown.deadline.Name: Countdown to Date
systems.garcia.countdown.deadline.Tooltip: Counts down to a date and time, or to a time every day. Tap to see the target. While ringing: tap to dismiss, hold to snooze.

systems.garcia.countdown.stopwatch.Name: Stopwatch
systems.garcia.countdown.stopwatch.Tooltip: Tap to start/pause, hold to reset. Lap mode: tap for a lap, hold to pause then reset. Keeps running across page changes and restarts.

systems.garcia.countdown.pomodoro.Name: Pomodoro
systems.garcia.countdown.pomodoro.Tooltip: Focus and break cycles. Tap to start/pause, hold to restart the cycle. When a phase ends: tap to start the next, hold to snooze.
